edges.sentence: On 2026-10-06, The Guardian reported “According to the latest data from the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) the US trade deficit for August has widened, and is now sitting at $105.6bn – up by more than 13% compared to July’s revised figures.”; on the same day, CNBC reported “Trade deficit hits $105.6 billion”.

On 2026-10-06, The Guardian reported “According to the latest data from the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) the US trade deficit for August has widened, and is now sitting at $105.6bn – up by more than 13% compared to July’s revised figures.”; on the same day, UPI reported “The deficit of $105.6 billion marked a jump of 13.7% from July, the U.S. Commerce Department reported Tuesday.”.

On 2026-10-06, UPI reported “The deficit of $105.6 billion marked a jump of 13.7% from July, the U.S. Commerce Department reported Tuesday.”; on the same day, CNBC reported “Trade deficit hits $105.6 billion”.
